projects.title: Thero Studio

projects.title: Petit Moments
projects.shortDescription: Bachelorproef app: pin personal moments on a map and connect them into a shared story.
projects.longDescription: Petit Moments is my bachelorproef — an app I fully designed and developed. Users pin personal moments and anecdotes on a map to share their story. For example, after a trip to London you can place each fun moment on the map, then follow them as a playlist through the rode draad: a red string that connects every moment into one continuous narrative.
features: Pin personal moments and anecdotes on an interactive map
Rode draad: follow connected moments like a playlist along a red string
Share location-based stories others can walk through
Fully designed and developed as bachelorproef

projects.title: Jongeren Annasr
projects.shortDescription: Visual identity, social media and communication for a youth vzw in Vilvoorde.

I manage their Instagram (@jongerenannasr) and create all graphics and communication needed — from the visual identity and logos to mission posts, opinion graphics, and event materials such as the buurtfeest poster.
features: Full visual identity and logo for a youth-focused vzw
Ongoing Instagram management and social content
All graphics and communication for the organisation
Event poster design (buurtfeest) using the full identity

projects.title: Zilal
projects.shortDescription: Mock brand identity for an e-commerce shop selling modest Islamic clothing for women.
projects.longDescription: Zilal is a mock case for an e-commerce shop selling modest Islamic clothing for women. The identity pairs an arched mark — a silhouette of a woman in hijab forming a subtle Z — with an elegant serif wordmark, built for a calm, contemporary fashion brand.
features: Primary and secondary logo system
Icon mark with Islamic architectural arch and modest silhouette
Brand sheet and Instagram post visuals
Direction suited for an online modest-fashion shop

projects.title: Lion's Eye Studio
projects.shortDescription: Custom logo redesign for a photography studio that needed to move away from an AI-generated mark.
projects.longDescription: Lion's Eye Studio is a photography studio that needed a new logo after their previous one was AI-generated. The owner realised that generating a logo with AI was a mistake — and that is when he came to me for a proper redesign. The new mark is a geometric line-art lion with a camera-lens eye, paired with a classic serif wordmark in dark and light variants.
features: Custom geometric lion mark (line art, camera-lens eye)
Stacked and horizontal logo lockups
Dark and light colour variants for flexible use
Human-designed identity replacing an AI-generated logo

projects.title: Petit Moments — UX/UI
projects.shortDescription: Full UX/UI and brand design for the Petit Moments bachelorproef app.
projects.longDescription: UX/UI and brand design for Petit Moments, my bachelorproef app. The visual system centres on the rode draad — a red string woven through the logo and the map experience — connecting personal moments into one story. The case covers the logo, huisstijl, and high-fidelity mobile screens for pinning and following moments on the map.
features: Logo with the rode draad woven through the pm monogram
Huisstijlgids and key visual on a map with connected moments
Mobile UI for feed, map, moment detail, and creating posts
Design system ready for development
